about: By offering a huge collection of car tinting Dubai, SAFA Automotive aims to provide simplified and scalable solutions to address the issues related to excessive UV rays, infrared radiation, scorching heat, and glare. Our new-age 3M window films can provide enhanced comfort, protection, and privacy.

Being an authorized 3M tinting centre in Dubai, SAFA Automotive comprises a broad range of window films. All our products are sourced from the 3M Company, which is the leading manufacturer of window films. Plus, they have been passed through several quality analysis tests to ensure unmatched quality. By reducing glare, these window tinting solutions aim to offer a safer driving experience.
